## TREK 1: Sar Pass Trek
- URL: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/sar-pass-trek
- Gallery: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/sar-pass-trek/gallery
- Price: ₹6,500 per person
- Duration: 5 Days
- Difficulty: Moderate
- Location: Parvati Valley, Himachal Pradesh
- Guide: Pritam Negi (8 Years experience, English / Hindi / Pahadi)
- Overview: Classic beginner-friendly trek in Parvati Valley. "Sar" means lake in the local dialect. Trail passes through pine forests, meadows, and villages with views of Himalayan peaks.
- Itinerary:
  - Day 1: Kasol to Grahan Village — 10 km, 7,700 ft
  - Day 2: Grahan to Min Thach — 7 km, 11,200 ft
  - Day 3: Min Thach to Nagaru — 8 km, 12,500 ft
  - Day 4: Nagaru to Biskeri Thach via Sar Pass — 14 km, 13,800 ft (pass summit)
  - Day 5: Biskeri Thach to Barshaini via Pulga — 6 km, 7,800 ft
- Highlights: Pine and rhododendron forests; Parvati Valley views; Grahan Village culture; frozen Sar Lake at 13,800 ft; snow slide descent

## TREK 2: Hampta Pass Trek
- URL: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/hampta-pass
- Gallery: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/hampta-pass/gallery
- Price: ₹9,500 per person
- Duration: 5 Days / 4 Nights
- Difficulty: Moderate
- Location: Kullu & Lahaul Spiti, Himachal Pradesh
- Basecamp: Manali, Himachal Pradesh
- Max Altitude: 14,100 ft
- Best Time: Mid June to October
- Trek Distance: 25 km
- Guide: Pritam Negi (8 Years experience, English / Hindi / Pahadi)
- Overview: Most dramatic crossover trek in the Himalayas — connects lush Kullu Valley with barren Lahaul. Sudden shift in scenery from forests to cold desert.
- Itinerary:
  - Day 1: Manali to Jobra (drive), trek to Chika — 2 km, 10,100 ft
  - Day 2: Chika to Balu Ka Ghera — 8.5 km, 11,900 ft
  - Day 3: Balu Ka Ghera to Shea Goru via Hampta Pass — 9 km, 12,900 ft (pass at 14,100 ft)
  - Day 4: Shea Goru to Chhatru — 5 km, 11,000 ft
  - Day 5: Chhatru to Chandratal (if roads open) and drive to Manali
- Inclusions: Dome tents (2-3 sharing), hot vegetarian meals, trek leader, permits, microspikes/gaiters, first aid
- Exclusions: Transport to/from Manali, backpack offloading, meals in transit, personal expenses/insurance

## TREK 3: Kedarkantha Trek
- URL: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/kedarkantha-trek
- Gallery: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/kedarkantha-trek/gallery
- Price: ₹3,500 per person
- Duration: 4 Days
- Difficulty: Moderate
- Location: Sankri, Uttarakhand
- Guide: Kapil Rawat (8 Years experience, English / Hindi / Garhwali)
- Overview: Finest winter trek in the Himalayas. Starting from Sankri, through pine forests, frozen lakes, and snow meadows. Summit at 12,500 ft with 360-degree views of Swargarohini, Black Peak, Bandarpoonch.
- Itinerary:
  - Day 1: Sankri to Juda-ka-Talab — 4 km, 9,100 ft
  - Day 2: Juda-ka-Talab to Base Camp — 4 km, 11,250 ft
  - Day 3: Summit (12,500 ft) and descent to Hargaon — 6 km
  - Day 4: Hargaon to Sankri — 6 km, 6,400 ft
- Highlights: Snowy summit climb; pine and oak forests; Juda-ka-Talab frozen lake; views of Swargarohini and Black Peak; stargazing

## TREK 4: Har Ki Dun Trek
- URL: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/har-ki-dun-trek
- Gallery: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/har-ki-dun-trek/gallery
- Price: ₹4,500 per person
- Duration: 5 Days
- Difficulty: Moderate
- Location: Sankri, Uttarakhand
- Guide: Kapil Rawat (8 Years experience, English / Hindi / Garhwali)
- Overview: "Valley of Gods" — historically significant trek in Govind Pashu Vihar National Park. Traces a path the Pandavas took to heaven. Ancient villages, rich flora, alpine meadows below glaciated peaks.
- Itinerary:
  - Day 1: Sankri to Pauni Garaat via Taluka — 10 km, 8,200 ft
  - Day 2: Pauni Garaat to Kalkatiyadhaar (past Osla village) — 7 km, 8,950 ft
  - Day 3: Kalkatiyadhaar to Har Ki Dun valley and back — 10 km, 11,700 ft
  - Day 4: Kalkatiyadhaar to Pauni Garaat — 7 km, 8,200 ft
  - Day 5: Pauni Garaat to Sankri — 10 km, 6,400 ft
- Highlights: Valley of the Gods; Osla ancient wooden architecture; Supin River camping; Himalayan wildlife; Swargarohini peak views

## TREK 5: Rupin Pass Trek
- URL: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/rupin-pass-trek
- Gallery: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/rupin-pass-trek/gallery
- Price: ₹15,500 per person
- Duration: 7 Days
- Difficulty: Hard
- Location: Shimla, Himachal Pradesh (start) — Uttarakhand (finish)
- Guide: Kapil Rawat (8 Years experience, English / Hindi / Garhwali)
- Overview: Most diverse and visually stunning trek in India. Connects Himachal Pradesh to Uttarakhand. At 15,250 ft, the pass has dramatic snow walls, hanging meadows, glacial rivers, and the Rupin waterfall.
- Itinerary:
  - Day 1: Shimla to Jiskun via Rohru (drive) — 7,700 ft
  - Day 2: Jiskun to Saruwas Thatch — 8 km, 9,800 ft
  - Day 3: Saruwas Thatch to Upper Waterfall — 6 km, 11,800 ft
  - Day 4: Upper Waterfall to Rati Pheri — 5 km, 13,600 ft
  - Day 5: Rati Pheri to Rupin Pass (15,250 ft) to Ronti Gad — 10 km, 12,500 ft
  - Day 6: Ronti Gad to Sangla Valley — 12 km, 8,600 ft
  - Day 7: Sangla to Shimla (drive)

## TREK 6: Buni Buni Pass Trek
- URL: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/buni-buni-pass
- Gallery: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/buni-buni-pass/gallery
- Price: ₹2,499 per person
- Duration: 2-3 Days
- Difficulty: Easy
- Location: Parvati Valley, Himachal Pradesh
- Guide: Pritam Negi (8 Years experience, English / Hindi / Pahadi)
- Overview: Spectacular offbeat alternative to crowded Kheerganga. Alpine meadows, dense forests, panoramic views up to ~11,000 ft. Option to combine with Kheerganga hot springs descent.
- Itinerary:
  - Day 1: Kalga to Buni Buni Pass — 8 km, 10,980 ft
  - Day 2: Buni Buni Pass to Kheerganga — 5 km, 9,700 ft
  - Day 3: Kheerganga to Barshaini — 12 km, 7,400 ft

## TREK 7: Dev Roopa Trek
- URL: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/dev-roopa-trek
- Gallery: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/dev-roopa-trek/gallery
- Price: ₹8,000 per person
- Duration: 5 to 6 Days
- Difficulty: Moderate
- Location: Parvati Valley, Himachal Pradesh (Malana region)
- Guides: Pritam Negi (8 Years) + Bhojraj (5 Years)
- Overview: "Descent of God" — offbeat trek in Malana region. Vast pristine grasslands, high-altitude glacial streams, meadows at ~14,000 ft. Away from crowds.
- Itinerary:
  - Day 1: Kasol to Malana Dam, trek to Waichin
  - Day 2: Waichin to Mota Grahan — 10,200 ft
  - Day 3: Mota Grahan to Bogdi — 6 km, 12,500 ft
  - Day 4: Bogdi to Dev Roopa meadows and back — 8 km, 14,100 ft
  - Day 5: Bogdi to Mota Grahan — 10,200 ft
  - Day 6: Trek to Malana Dam and drive to Kasol

## TREK 8: Kareri Lake Trek
- URL: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/kareri-lake-trek
- Gallery: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/kareri-lake-trek/gallery
- Price: ₹1,500 per person
- Duration: 2 Days
- Difficulty: Easy
- Location: Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh
- Guide: Aatish (7 Years experience, English / Hindi / Pahadi)
- Overview: Pristine glacial lake in Dhauladhar range at 9,626 ft. Trail through oak, deodar, rhododendron forests; Gaddi shepherds' settlements; Dhauladhar peak reflections in the lake.
- Itinerary:
  - Day 1: Dharamshala to Kareri Village, trek to Lioti — 8 km, 8,200 ft
  - Day 2: Lioti to Kareri Lake — 6 km, 9,626 ft
  - Day 3: Kareri Lake to Kareri Village, drive to Dharamshala — 14 km, 6,200 ft

## TREK 9: Kheerganga Trek
- URL: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/kheerganga-trek
- Gallery: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/kheerganga-trek/gallery
- Price: ₹999 per person
- Duration: 2 Days
- Difficulty: Easy
- Location: Parvati Valley, Himachal Pradesh
- Guide: Pritam Negi (8 Years experience, English / Hindi / Pahadi)
- Overview: Most popular beginners' trek in Himachal. Natural hot springs at 9,700 ft. Pine forests, Himachali villages, Parvati River. Lord Shiva is said to have meditated here for 3,000 years.
- Itinerary:
  - Day 1: Barshaini to Kheerganga via Nakthan and Rudra Nag — 12 km, 9,700 ft
  - Day 2: Kheerganga to Barshaini — 12 km, 7,500 ft

## TREK 10: Baraadsar Lake Trek
- URL: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/baraadsar-lake-trek
- Gallery: https://unchartedtravel.in/destinations/baraadsar-lake-trek/gallery
- Price: ₹20,999 per person
- Duration: 7 Days (suggested)
- Difficulty: Hard
- Location: Uttarkashi, Uttarakhand / Himachal Pradesh border
- Guide: Kailash Rawat (20 Years experience, Hindi / Pahadi)
- Overview: Sacred high-altitude lake near Uttarakhand-Himachal border at ~4,300 m (14,108 ft). Sits between Rupin and Supin valleys on high ridges. Route: Kasla → Rala → Daldhar → Devbhasa → Baraadsar. Expect steep sections, remote camps, scarce water. Seven-day plan is suggested; guide confirms camps based on snow and weather.
- Itinerary:
  - Day 1: Arrive in Sankri — meet guide, check equipment
  - Day 2: Sankri to Kasla (drive), trek to Rala — 5 km, 7,546 ft
  - Day 3: Rala to Devbhasa via Daldhar — 8 km, 11,975 ft
  - Day 4: Devbhasa to high camp via Baraadsar ridge (snow-dependent)
  - Day 5: Baraadsar Lake (14,108 ft) and begin descent — 14 km round trip
  - Day 6: Descend towards Rala — 7-8 km, 8,840 ft
  - Day 7: Return to Kasla and Sankri — 3 km
